markdown_content: # Digitizing charts A common source of data is images published in journal articles, textbooks, or on the web. We've been relying on prepared `CSV` files to do our data analysis with Python so far, but this isn't representative of the real world. Let's try using [WebPlotDigitizer](https://apps.automeris.io/wpd/) to obtain raw data from the following chart of mechanical performance of an architected material from [mechanical performance of an architected material](https://doi.org/10.1088/1757-899X/433/1/012078):
